transcript.answer: The threshold is set through the `LORE_FACT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD` environment variable. Its default value is 0.92 cosine similarity. It is described in FR-2.3 of specs/temporal-fact-invalidation/spec.md and added in task T006 of that feature's tasks.md. It is applied by `invalidateContradictions()` in `facts.ts` (libs/server-core/src/work/memory/). A new fact whose similarity to an existing valid fact is at or above 0.92 invalidates the old fact. specs/2-agent-memory/spec.md also states the 0.92 value. I only saw the spec text, not the source code, so I did not check the variable's definition in the code itself.
